name: Sushi Bar Avocado Roll (Wrapped in Soft Soy Paper / Mamenori)
whyItWorks: Ripe, creamy Hass avocado wrapped with seasoned white sushi rice in paper-thin soy paper (mamenori). Bypasses tough, fibrous sheets of nori seaweed which can be difficult to break down for patients with strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Avocado Roll wrapped in soy paper (soy wrapper) instead of nori—NO sesame seeds on top, NO wasabi.'
